items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: he was one of the finest men that I ever met in my life, and one of my best friends

ctx.x: Well, you knew a lot of the controversy that went on with him with the police department, and he was one of the finest men that I ever met in my life, and one of my best friends. And he used to come in and sit down and drink while I was playing all the time. And one of the first jobs I had also was at the, I was the first piano player they ever had in the spotlight bar, which is where the Royal Sinesta is now. The spotlight was right across the street from the famous door.
